Name: Vintage Industrial Decor
Author: Everbloom1
Description:
[center][size=5][font=Arial Black]Installation & Usage[/font][/size][/center]
[center][font=Verdana][size=2]﻿﻿┈┈・୨ ✦ ୧・┈┈﻿[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Verdana][size=4][CP] Vintage Industrial Decor[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Obtain furniture through:[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]The Furniture Catalogue[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Alternatively, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]﻿Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] (search for "[b][color=#f1c232]vid_[/color][/b]")[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][center][font=Verdana][size=1]﻿﻿✦[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Verdana]﻿[size=3]Optional Features[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Animated ceiling fan (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url]﻿)[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Functional calendar (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿)[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Open cooking menu through the refridgerator (Requires Calcifer)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][center][font=Verdana][size=1]﻿﻿✦﻿[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Verdana][size=2][b]Note:[/b] The added Retro TV is [i]a decorative furniture piece only[/i]. For a functional TV, you can download the retexture from optional files.[/size][/font]
[center][font=Verdana]✦﻿[/font][/center]
[font=Verdana][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Optional retexture of Budget TV and Retro TV[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Customize the textures of Budget TV and Retro TV with the Paint Bucket tool (from Alternative Textures).[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][center][font=Verdana][size=2]﻿✦﻿[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Verdana][size=4][AT] Vintage Industrial Decor[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Customize the textures with the Paint Bucket tool (from Alternative Textures).[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][color=#f1c232][size=2][b]Note:[/b] A few furniture items have different sizes or hitboxes compared to the CP version.[/size][/color][/font]
[font=Verdana]Furniture list:[/font]
[spoiler][font=Verdana]ArtistBookcase
BambooMat

[center][font=Verdana][size=2]﻿┈┈・୨ ✦ ୧・┈┈﻿﻿[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Verdana][size=3]Tips for Pendant Lights and Ceiling Fan:[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Hitbox: The "click spot" for picking them up is the bottom-left tile.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Collision: Even though the tile looks empty, it has a 1x1 hitbox that will block your path.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][center][font=Verdana][size=2]┈┈・୨ ✦ ୧・┈┈﻿[/size][/font][/center]
[center][size=5][font=Arial Black]Compatibility[/font][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]SMAPI 4.2.1[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Content Patcher 2.7.2[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Alternative Textures 8.0.0[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Calcifer 0.1.0[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]SpaceCore 1.28.0[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][size=2]If you encounter any issues, please leave a comment with your SMAPI log.[/size][/font]
